work.author: Church of England, in the Convocations of Canterbury and York
work.description: The 1662 Book of Common Prayer in the form of the manuscript annexed to the Act of Uniformity. Its Sundays after Trinity run one ahead of the Roman Sundays after Pentecost, so the Roman Fourteenth after Pentecost is Trinity XV, whose collect is Cranmer's rendering of the Sarum Latin. No edition consulted in this run prints a source apparatus for the collects, so that derivation is an identification by comparison and not a statement any of these books makes.
work.title: The Book of Common Prayer annexed to the Act of Uniformity of 1662
